title: Register a new receipt and verify it appears in the receipts table
description: Verifies a school user can create a receipt with model, description, size, and quantity and then see it listed.

steps.description: Verify element "Recebimentos" is visible in the main menu or page content
Click on "Recebimentos" in the sidebar menu
Select a uniform model from the model dropdown
Type "Recebimento de teste" into the description field
Select a size from the size dropdown
Click the save button to register receipt
Verify text "Recebimento de teste" is visible in the receipts table

title: Filter receipts by year and model after creating a receipt
description: Verifies filtering by year and model updates the list to show matching results including the newly created receipt.

steps.description: Click on "Recebimentos" in the sidebar menu
Select a uniform model from the model dropdown
Type "Filtro ano modelo" into the description field
Select a size from the size dropdown
Click the save button to register receipt
Verify text "Filtro ano modelo" is visible in the receipts table
Select the current year from the year filter dropdown
Select the same uniform model from the model filter dropdown
Verify text "Filtro ano modelo" is visible in the receipts table

title: Quantity required validation: attempt save with empty quantity then successfully save
description: Verifies the form blocks saving without quantity, shows validation, and then allows save after quantity is filled.

steps.description: Click on "Recebimentos" in the sidebar menu
Select a uniform model from the model dropdown
Type "Sem quantidade" into the description field
Select a size from the size dropdown
Click the save button to register receipt
Verify text "Quantidade" is visible as a validation message or required-field indicator
Click the save button to register receipt
Verify text "Sem quantidade" is visible in the receipts table

title: Cancel/clear behavior: ensure the form does not create a receipt without clicking Save
description: Verifies that typing values without saving does not create a new record in the receipts table.

steps.description: Click on "Recebimentos" in the sidebar menu
Select a uniform model from the model dropdown
Type "Nao salvar" into the description field
Select a size from the size dropdown
Click on "Lançamentos" in the sidebar menu
Click on "Recebimentos" in the sidebar menu
Verify text "Nao salvar" is not visible in the receipts table

Verify text "Modelo" is visible near the filters or table header

title: Create a new transfer and see it appear in transfer history
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a transfer between two schools with items and then see it listed in the transfer history.

steps.description: Click on "Transferências" in the sidebar menu
Select an option from the "Escola de origem" (Origin school) dropdown
Select a different option from the "Escola de destino" (Destination school) dropdown
Click on the "Adicionar item" (Add item) button
Select an option from the "Produto" (Product) dropdown for the new item
Type "1" into the "Quantidade" (Quantity) field for the new item
Verify the transfer appears in the history list

title: Prevent transfer creation when quantity exceeds available stock
description: Verifies the UI blocks submission and shows an insufficient stock message when the requested quantity is higher than available.

steps.description: Click on "Transferências" in the sidebar menu
Select an option from the "Escola de origem" (Origin school) dropdown
Select a different option from the "Escola de destino" (Destination school) dropdown
Click on the "Adicionar item" (Add item) button
Select an option from the "Produto" (Product) dropdown for the new item
Type "999999" into the "Quantidade" (Quantity) field for the new item

title: Validation: block submission when origin school is not selected

steps.description: Click on "Transferências" in the sidebar menu
Select an option from the "Escola de destino" (Destination school) dropdown
Click on the "Adicionar item" (Add item) button
Select an option from the "Produto" (Product) dropdown for the new item
Type "1" into the "Quantidade" (Quantity) field for the new item

Type "1" into the "Quantidade" (Quantity) field for the new item

title: Validation: block submission when origin and destination are the same school

steps.description: Click on "Transferências" in the sidebar menu
Select an option from the "Escola de origem" (Origin school) dropdown
Select the same option from the "Escola de destino" (Destination school) dropdown
Click on the "Adicionar item" (Add item) button
Select an option from the "Produto" (Product) dropdown for the new item
Type "1" into the "Quantidade" (Quantity) field for the new item

title: Validation: block submission when no transfer items were added
description: Verifies the user cannot submit a transfer without at least one item.

steps.description: Click on "Transferências" in the sidebar menu
Select an option from the "Escola de origem" (Origin school) dropdown
Select a different option from the "Escola de destino" (Destination school) dropdown

title: Validation: reject zero or negative quantity for a transfer item
description: Verifies quantity must be a positive number to submit a transfer.

steps.description: Click on "Transferências" in the sidebar menu
Select an option from the "Escola de origem" (Origin school) dropdown
Select a different option from the "Escola de destino" (Destination school) dropdown
Click on the "Adicionar item" (Add item) button

Verify text "válida" or "maior que 0" is visible
